label.en: remotely invested central secretariat left grand councillor

translationRepairs: Emperor Mingzong, posthumous name Yixian Jingxiao, taboo name Arig Temür, was Wuzong's eldest son.
Emperor Mingzong, posthumous name Yixian Jingxiao, taboo name Khoshila, was Wuzong's eldest son.
s0001 諱和世㻋 is Mingzong's personal name Khoshila; Arig Temür is unsupported by the Chinese.
Emperor Mingzong, posthumous name Yixian Jingxiao, taboo name Arig Temür, was Wuzong's eldest son.
Emperor Mingzong, posthumous name Yixian Jingxiao, taboo name Khoshila, was Wuzong's eldest son.
The same 諱和世㻋 requires Khoshila in the literal field; Arig Temür is a false personal name.
First year of Tianli, first month, on yichou day, Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür to welcome him.
Second year of Tianli, first month, on yichou day, Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür to welcome him.
s0043 opens 天歷二年正月乙丑; 二年 is the second year of Tianli, not the first.
First year of Tianli, first month, on yichou day, Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür to welcome him.
Second year of Tianli, first month, on yichou day, Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür to welcome him.
Literal likewise misreads 天歷二年 as first year; Second year of Tianli restores the Chinese date.
Hanlin academician-director Tangqutu was promoted to grand preceptor.
Hanlin academician-director Tangut was promoted to grand marshal.
s0117 加翰林學士承旨唐兀為太尉: 唐兀 is Tangut and 太尉 is grand marshal, not Tangqutu/grand preceptor (太師).
Hanlin academician-director Tangqutu was promoted to grand preceptor.
Hanlin academician-director Tangut was promoted to grand marshal.
The literal has the same errors: 唐兀→Tangut and 太尉→grand marshal, matching chapter usage of both terms.

On renwu day envoys were dispatched to the capital, directing central secretariat associate administrator Qabildar together with Hanlin National History Academy officials to perform sacrifice to the imperial portraits of the three reigns of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong.

On renwu day envoys were dispatched to the capital, directing central secretariat grand councillor Qabarqu together with Hanlin National History Academy officials to perform sacrifice to the imperial portraits of the three reigns of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong.
s0161 中書平章政事哈八兒禿 is central secretariat grand councillor Qabarqu; Qabildar and associate administrator misread name and office.
Twelfth month, on yisi day, privy council administrator Chenye Bulun and others deliberated and requested the posthumous title Emperor Yixian Jingxiao and the temple name Mingzong.
Twelfth month, on yisi day, privy council administrator Yebulun and others deliberated and requested the posthumous title Emperor Yixian Jingxiao and the temple name Mingzong.
s0168 知樞密院事臣也不倫: 臣 is the memorial self-reference; the name is 也不倫 (Yebulun), not Chenye Bulun.
Twelfth month, on yisi day, privy council administrator Chenye Bulun and others deliberated and requested the posthumous title Emperor Yixian Jingxiao and the temple name Mingzong.
Twelfth month, on yisi day, privy council administrator Yebulun and others deliberated and requested the posthumous title Emperor Yixian Jingxiao and the temple name Mingzong.
The literal likewise absorbs 臣 into the name; Yebulun correctly separates the honorific from 也不倫.
Yuan Shi, juan 31: First month of Tianshun 2, on yichou day Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left associate administrator Yiltemur to welcome him.
Yuan Shi, juan 31: First month of Tianli 2, on yichou day Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left associate administrator Yiltemur to welcome him.
s0171 天厯二年 is the Tianli (天歷) era, not Tianshun; the proposed era name correction is accurate.
Yuan Shi, juan 31: First month of Tianshun 2, on yichou day Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left associate administrator Yiltemur to welcome him.
Yuan Shi, juan 31: First month of Tianli 2, on yichou day Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left associate administrator Yiltemur to welcome him.
Literal likewise misreads 天厯 as Tianshun; Tianli restores the era named in the annotation.
